Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
RootDirectory=/opt/inventory-chroot
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/inventory
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-worker
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
non-root-owned-chroot-objects:
d drwxr-x--- inventorysvc:inventorysvc /opt/inventory-chroot/var/lib/inventory
f -rw------- inventorysvc:inventorysvc /opt/inventory-chroot/var/lib/inventory/worker.pid
f -rw------- inventorysvc:inventorysvc /opt/inventory-chroot/var/lib/inventory/heartbeat
final-runtime-state:
active
enabled
boot_id=dfc3cc83-11d6-4e14-9a16-1ef19d7d15c9
